title: stabilize-burst-sensitive-latency-fence-with-confidence-weighted-probes
author: Anika Patel
description:
Motivation: We observed a recurring failure mode in canary evaluations where short-duration traffic bursts (e.g. client-side retries or periodic background flurries) caused transient latency spikes that tripped rollback gates even though steady-state behavior remained within SLOs. This PR introduces a burst-sensitive latency fence that reduces false-positive rollbacks by combining confidence-weighted probes, autocorrelation-aware probe alignment, and an adaptive cooldown window.

Summary of changes: adds a new probe scheduler that (1) computes per-probe confidence scores based on sample size and recent variance, (2) aligns probe windows to detected traffic autocorrelation lags to avoid sampling during short synchronized bursts, (3) replaces the hard percentile threshold with a Bayesian credibility interval check so evidence accumulates smoothly, and (4) applies a dynamically-sized cooldown when the fence detects burst-induced anomalies, allowing routing hedges (partial spillover to fallback model variant) instead of full rollback.

Why different: Unlike the existing percentile or ensemble detectors this approach explicitly models burstiness and uncertainty rather than treating each measurement as equally informative. It preserves sensitivity for genuine regressions (longer sustained degradation) while reducing churn from short-lived noise.

Testing and validation: unit tests for the confidence-weighting math, integration tests that replay historical traces with injected synthetic bursts, and a synthetic A/B in perf-canary environment comparing false-positive rate on 12 production traces. The PR includes a short canary run (see commits) demonstrating a 72% reduction in spurious rollbacks on replayed burst-heavy traces while maintaining >95% detection power for sustained 10% latency regressions across the same traces.

Rollout plan: feature gate off by default. Canary in perf-canary namespace for 48h; enable hedged routing at 10% traffic, increase to 50% after clean metrics. Documented config knobs (confidence_alpha, cooldown_base_ms, alignment_max_lag) in the README.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in Linear (ENG-2741) - [x] Unit tests + integration replays - [x] E2E synthetic canary run artifacts attached to PR - [x] Feature-gate + runtime flags - [x] Dashboard panels added for confidence and alignment metrics

Commits summary: "Initial implementation of confidence-weighted probe scheduler" (core algorithm + tests); "autocorrelation alignment and cooldown" (scheduling + heuristics); "routing hedging integration" (partial spillover + metrics); "docs and canary artifacts" (README updates, dashboard queries).

review_comments: Diego Martinez (2026-02-26): Nice focused approach. Two asks: (1) can you add a short note about the prior you use for the Bayesian interval (it looks like an uninformative prior now), and (2) ensure the cooldown doesn't allow a repeated oscillation if the underlying service briefly recovers then drops again?

Author - Anika Patel (2026-02-27): Added a comment in latency_fence.py documenting the weakly-informative prior (Normal-inverse-gamma) and a test that simulates oscillation with back-to-back bursts; cooldown now grows multiplicatively up to a cap. PTAL.

Rachel Ng (2026-02-28): Tests look good. Suggest exposing alignment_max_lag as a percentage of observed autocorr period instead of absolute ms, makes it more portable across services. Also observed a flake in test_cw_scheduler under low-sample random seed - can you add deterministic seeding?
Author - Anika Patel (2026-03-01): Updated config to support percentage-based lag, and added deterministic seeds to the flaky test. Re-ran the replay suite; attached results to PR.
Marco Fernandez (2026-03-01): Approve after minor nits addressed in docs. Verified dashboard panels render in perf-canary staging.

release_notes: Performance: Add burst-sensitive latency fence with confidence-weighted probes to reduce false-positive canary rollbacks. New knobs: confidence_alpha, cooldown_base_ms, alignment_max_lag. Feature gated and disabled by default.
notes_for_oncall: If the new fence causes missed detection, disable via deploy/feature_flags.yaml (set perf.canary.burst_fence.enabled=false) and notify ENG-2741. Metrics to inspect: perf.canary.latency_fence.confidence, perf.canary.latency_fence.alignment_lag_ms, perf.canary.rollout.hedge_rate.
